## recv-wazuh-alert (contract C1, N8N-1.1)
**Trigger:** POST /webhook/wazuh-alert from the Wazuh `custom-n8n` integration, header `X-ASOX-Token` required (403 without it, N8N-1.6). Answers 200 on receipt (C1 has a 10 s timeout and no retries).
**Inputs:** raw Wazuh alert JSON (body). The full alert stays in this execution (the C1 check looks for it here).
**Actions taken:** reads lib-config; drops alerts below WAZUH_ALERT_MIN_LEVEL ("filtered: level ..."); skips intake exclusions (TEMPORARY: rule group sca, "skipped: sca (X-09)"); hands every other alert to pb-generic without waiting. That single call site is where the Router de Playbooks (N8N-1.3) goes.
**Systems changed:** none here (pb-generic changes TheHive).
**Approval:** not applicable.
**Owner:** n8n.
Error workflow: recv-n8n-error.

// Only the body goes further: the request headers carry the webhook token.
return [{ json: { alert: $input.first().json.body } }];
